title: Introduction
author: 645ed7a98664cb37fb18ff9b
chapter_outcomes: Nature of liability in negligence: personal liability, vicarious liability (in outline only) and joint liability
Duty of care: the neighbour principle and the modern three-part test (Caparo test); the importance of policy considerations
Breach of duty: the standard of care and the objective test; the standard of care and different classes of defendant – children, experts and professionals
Causation and remoteness of damage: factual and legal causation, multiple causes and intervening acts; the test for remoteness of damage
Novel duty situations: pure economic loss and liability for negligent misstatement; liability for nervous shock; restrictions on the scope of the duty and policy considerations; possible reforms
